title: NoteBatchInformation and NoteInformation to backend-neutral NoteSpec adapter

adapter_contract.lane_width: ButtonTypesArray, or buttonType when the baked array is absent, retains the internal contiguous half-button range; #HABAHIRO source lanes are retained separately through cc_nums using CC suffixes 11..15 -> lanes 1..5, 16 -> lane 0 and 18 -> lane 6

root_types.4: Slide A root only when isSlideNoteHead or slideNoteList identifies the root
root_types.5: curved Slide B root only when isSlideNoteHead or slideNoteList identifies the root

adapter_contract.filtered_types: GameNoteType -1 and terminal or additional types 3, 6..9 and 12..25 do not create independent NoteSpec roots
adapter_contract.long: afterNoteAbsolutePos and AfterNoteType become the end position and end gesture; matching adjacent type 18 or 19 additions increase the multiple-direction count
adapter_contract.slide: the final slideNoteList member becomes the terminal; preceding members become ordered intermediate positions, lanes, widths and visibility flags
adapter_contract.multiple_slide: AfterNoteType 11 or 12 selects matching terminal-family add nodes 20..23 from the contiguous lane component at the terminal position
adapter_contract.virtual_lane: root and Slide terminal VirtualLaneDirection and VirtualLaneDistance map independently
adapter_contract.source_order: informationList order is materialized as source_order when the caller did not provide it, preserving the confirmed chart-driven multiple-direction activation order
adapter_contract.directional_anchor_lane: standalone multiple-direction Flick preserves the direction endpoint button separately from the minimum lane and contiguous baked width
adapter_contract.multi_range_cc: NoteInformationRecord and NoteSpec preserve root, Long-terminal and every Slide-node CC set independently from the internal ButtonTypesArray merge result
adapter_contract.additional_types: root and terminal GameNoteAdditionalType plus skill indices are projected into NoteSpec without inventing downstream Fever or Skill behavior; additional type 4 is separated into LaneChangeCommandSpec before sync planning
adapter_contract.sync_connections: SyncConnectionSpec retains explicit front/end ownership, target endpoint identity, far-left/far-right selection and optional Slide side-node identity; sync_target_id remains the compatible front-owner view

confirmed: setupLongNotePair stores terminal absolute position and maps terminal GameNoteType 3, 12 and 13 to AfterNoteType 1, 2 and 3 on the Long root
setupSlideNoteSet marks one head, appends later members to its slideNoteList and writes the terminal AfterNoteType family
NoteSlide activation consumes only the final slideNoteList member for the terminal subclass
multiple-direction add types are family-specific and valid graph members are lane-adjacent
ButtonTypesArray is the baked runtime lane collection used by front and Slide intermediate render paths
terminal and additional NoteInformation objects remain support members and are not independent playable roots
the locked production chart yields 825 playable NoteSpec roots and matches every independent Single, Directional, Long and source Slide field
all 298 independent authoring Slide nodes remain ordered subsequences of the 1577 runtime-expanded Slide nodes
the production #HABAHIRO chart preserves 767 CC-bearing records and 311 combined CC sets without dropping equal-button different-CC sources
all 821 Single lanes, 65 Directional fields, 104 Long lane paths and 293 Slide lane nodes match the independent multi-range oracle
the 51 multi-range Slide roots retain all 141 authoring nodes as ordered subsequences of 626 runtime-expanded nodes
same-position Long and Slide After candidates are consumed before the ordinary front chain, remaining ordinary After endpoints pair at batch end, and multiple-direction endpoints expand outward
runtime sync-line geometry resolves front, Long end, Slide end and selected Slide side-node endpoints independently
the production HABAHIRO marker is separated into one LaneChangeCommandSpec at position 1728 while 598 playable NoteSpec roots retain all 266 sync connections
inference: note_id is backend adapter identity and not a recovered serialized NoteInformation field
source_order is an adapter representation of confirmed informationList traversal order and not a recovered field name
sound_effect_type remains optional caller metadata because its final runtime value is not stored in the recovered NoteInformation layout
unresolved: GameNoteAdditionalType Skill and Fever metadata is projected, but its UI, score and activation consumers plus BPM command behavior remain separate boundaries
standalone multiple-direction Flick grouping is represented by contiguous count but its reciprocal rendered back-line ownership is not yet projected from the batch adapter
sound_effect_type and concrete CRI cue selection still require the downstream judgement object construction chain
